hotTakes: Pineapple on pizza is culinary brilliance and purists are cowardly.
Voice notes longer than 30 seconds are an act of psychological warfare.
Making your bed every single morning is a meaningless ritual for control freaks.
European vacations are massively overrated compared to Southeast Asian chaos.
Coffee tastes like bitter dirt; humanity is just held hostage by caffeine addiction.
The TV show 'Friends' has never produced a single genuine belly laugh.
Texting back with just the letter 'k' is completely valid and efficient.
Waking up at 5:00 AM to work out is performative cult behavior.
Cereal is undeniably a form of cold breakfast soup.
Full-grown adults obsessed with theme parks are harboring secret darkness.
Destination weddings are expensive hostage situations forced upon friends.
Beyoncé makes decent tracks, but the cultural deity status is ridiculous.
Leaving dirty pans in the sink 'to soak' is an outright lie we tell ourselves.
Instagram 'Close Friends' stories exist exclusively for unhinged thirst traps and drama.
Marvel cinematic universe peaked at Endgame and everything since is slop.
Passengers stuck in the middle airplane seat should receive complimentary drinks and cash.
Listening to audiobooks or podcasts at 2x speed means you hate the content.
Board games like Monopoly destroy more households than infidelity.
Straight-out-of-the-fridge cold pizza dominates piping fresh delivery every time.
Splitting a dining bill evenly when someone ordered three cocktails and a steak is theft.
Cats are objectively superior to dogs because their affection must be earned.
People who do not return grocery shopping carts cannot be trusted in civil society.
Wearing fresh white sneakers with a tailored formal suit looks awful 100% of the time.
Smartphones at house parties have killed spontaneous late-night lore.
Astrology and zodiac compatibility are modern adult horoscopes for avoiding accountability.
Tipping percentages on tablet checkout screens have crossed into daylight extortion.
Watermelon is simply crunchy sugar water with terrible texture.
Every website and mobile application should default to dark mode by international law.
People who clap when an airplane touches down should have their passports checked.
Having over 5,000 unread emails in your inbox is a clear signal of spiritual chaos.
Random shower thoughts hold more wisdom than ninety percent of university lectures.
Movie theater popcorn pricing is the most successful legalized cartel in history.
Nobody in recorded human history has ever enjoyed small talk about the weekend weather.
Sleeping in bed with socks on is deeply unnerving behavior.
If you attend a house party and refuse to dance, you should be assigned to trash duty.
